description: What the Security review produced. The prose belongs in the issues and comments you already write with gh; this is the machine-readable record of what this run brought into existence, so a later reader can tell which role filed which issue. Every key is required.

filed.description: Issue numbers YOU created during this review. Empty when the review was clean, which is the commonest outcome and a real answer. The issues of every role are authored by the same App account, so this is the only record of which role filed which issue.

items.description: The issue number, as an integer. A bare number: not a URL, and not prefixed with a hash.

clean.description: true when the review found nothing worth filing or saying. On a merge trigger a clean review posts nothing at all, so this is the only signal that the run ran and found nothing - which is not the same as a run that failed.
